ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To send pictures in your conversations and pick the photo of your agents and your own.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: To take pictures for your conversations, for your agents' photo and your own, and to scan QR codes.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: To save pictures from your conversations to Photos.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: To record voice messages and to talk on voice calls.
